title: Tenure Allowance for Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Tiers
content:
At the tier review of a Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, the tenure allowance rests on the calendar days from the plan's hire date, as the employer's payroll file reports it, to the payday reviewed:

| Calendar days from hire date to the payday | Highest tier allowed |
|---|---|
| 365 or more | Paystride Access Premier Plus |
| 180 to 364 | Paystride Access Premier |
| 90 to 179 | Paystride Access Preferred |
| 60 to 89 | Paystride Access Plus |
| 30 to 59 | Paystride Access Standard |
| fewer than 30 | Paystride Access Starter only |

The days are the calendar-day difference between the hire date and the payday.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

- Hire date 1 February, payday 2 March of the same non-leap year: 29 days, Paystride Access Starter only; payday 3 March: 30 days, Paystride Access Standard.
- 179 days allow Paystride Access Preferred; 180 days allow Paystride Access Premier.
- 364 days allow Paystride Access Premier; 365 days allow Paystride Access Premier Plus.
